description: Doctrine-labeled quality corpus for the content-critic evolution cycle. Labels follow the surgical-writing doctrine: good texts are specific, concrete, time-bound, and measured; bad texts rely on hype, vagueness, or unrealistic claims. Labels were fixed before any scorer was run against the corpus.
